text: ñāṇaṃ hoti . khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . paṭhamaṃ . [2] cakkhuṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ . sotaṃ dukkhaṃ .pe. ghānaṃ dukkhaṃ . jivhā dukkhā . kāyo dukkho . mano dukkho yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattā yadanattā taṃ
